c: In Aurora’s heritage commercial core the damage risk during a retail store cleanout is often worth more than everything being removed, and we price the protection in rather than hoping it goes well. Sheeting the frontage and disassembling fixtures takes longer than dragging them out, and that time is in the quote from the start.

Aurora’s larger-format retail runs conventionally. SmartCentres Aurora and the big-box units along Wellington, Bayview and Leslie carry full-height racking, deep back-of-house and dedicated loading. The independent restaurants concentrated through the Yonge Street core sit somewhere between the two — modern kitchens fitted into period buildings, where a base-condition lease means the whole fit-out has to come out without damaging the structure it was built into. We confirm the format, the fixture scope and what the lease requires at the walkthrough before quoting.

blocks.text: RETAIL CLEANOUT SERVICES FAQ
Retail Cleanout Services in Aurora — FAQs

items.q: How much do retail cleanout services cost in Aurora?
a: Your price depends on the volume of material, the fixture removal involved and the care the building requires. We confirm the figure free of charge at the walkthrough and hold it through to completion. Property value, location in town, urgency and the number of units do not affect the rate.

items.q: My unit is a heritage storefront on Yonge Street. Can you work in it safely?
a: Yes, and it is routine for us here. We sheet the frontage, glazing, doorframes and interior finishes before starting, and disassemble fixtures rather than forcing them. That protection labour is priced into your quote from the outset rather than added afterwards.

items.q: Do you charge more because Aurora is an affluent area?
a: No. Your quote is calculated on volume and labour, never on the postal code or what the property is worth.

items.q: Can you clear a restaurant including the kitchen fit-out?
a: Yes. Line equipment, walk-ins, hoods, prep tables, bar builds and banquettes are removed, and where the lease requires base condition the fit-out comes out as light interior demolition in the same visit.

items.q: My restaurant is in a period building. Can the kitchen come out without damaging it?
a: Yes, and it is the most demanding job we take in Aurora. Modern kitchens fitted into period buildings were built around whatever the structure allowed, so we protect original masonry, frontages and interior finishes before anything is disconnected.
